description: Configure messages that should get send when a user joins a Voice-Channel

content.name: assignRoleToUsersInVoiceChannels
content.humanName: Assign roles to members connected to voice channels?
content.description: If enabled, users will receive a role when they join a voice channel. This role will be removed when they leave the voice channel (switching voice channels does not trigger a role removal).

content.name: voiceRoles
content.humanName: Roles for users that are connected to voice channels
content.description: Users that are currently connected to a voice channel will be assigned these roles.
